verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs say native embedding is generally available. They also say it embeds text on both writes and queries, so you don't integrate an embedding provider, which directly removes the separate embedding pipeline. Missing for 10: documentation of which models or configurable providers are available and how they're selected, in-depth docs beyond one-line mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline

citations.quote: turbopuffer embeds your text on writes and queries and you don't integrate an embedding provider at all
Embed without an API call: native embedding is generally available
